description: Append-only ledger of provenance_family_id clusters exposed during taxonomy construction, 0.2-0.4-draft coverage/tagging passes, or Phase 6 held-out evaluation. All 98 IDs are burned into dev; prospective held_out_test and reserve slices require freshly curated, single-work post-cutoff external clusters.
